test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Isha can do a certain piece of work in 22 days. Isha and Smriti can together do the same work in 11 days, and Isha, Smriti and Ashlesha can do the same work together in 10 days. In how many days can Isha and Ashlesha do the same work?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Total Work = LCM of (22, 11, 10) = 110 units.

Efficiency of Isha = 110 ÷ 22 = 5 units/day.

Efficiency of Ashlesha = (110 ÷ 10) − (110 ÷ 11) = 11 − 10 = 1 unit/day.

Combined efficiency of Isha and Ashlesha = 5 + 1 = 6 units/day.

Time taken = Total Work ÷ Combined Efficiency = 110 ÷ 6 = 55/3 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 55/3 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by Isha = 22 days

Time taken by Isha + Smriti = 11 days

Time taken by Isha + Smriti + Ashlesha = 10 days

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Time × Efficiency

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total work is the LCM of 22, 11, and 10, which is 110 units.

⇒ Efficiency of Isha = 110 ÷ 22 = 5 units/day.

⇒ Efficiency of Ashlesha = Efficiency of (Isha + Smriti + Ashlesha) − Efficiency of (Isha + Smriti)

⇒ Efficiency of Ashlesha = 11 − 10 = 1 unit/day.

⇒ Combined efficiency of Isha and Ashlesha = 5 + 1 = 6 units/day.

⇒ Time taken by Isha and Ashlesha = Total Work ÷ Combined Efficiency

⇒ Time taken = 110 ÷ 6 = 55/3 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 55/3 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes & Cisterns

Works exactly like Time & Work, but filling pipes have positive efficiency and emptying pipes have negative efficiency.

Work & Wages

Wages are distributed in direct proportion to the amount of total work done by each individual. If they work for the same number of days, wages are shared in the ratio of their efficiencies.

Alternate Day Work

When individuals work on alternate days, calculate the work done in a complete cycle of days, then determine the remaining work and assign it to the correct person in sequence.
